business_scope.primary_industry_name: Tier-3/4 Server Rack Space Leasing and Bare-Metal Server Hosting

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: US-derived common law (Business Corporations Act modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law) with customary law elements; presidential representative democracy in free association with the United States
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (economic and trade provisions)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with the United States
Tax Information Exchange Agreements with Australia, New Zealand and the Nordic countries (Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended and consolidated, administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2014 (AML/CFT Act 2014); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Regulations 2015; Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) established under the AML/CFT Act 2014 within the Ministry of Finance.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport for each natural-person shareholder, director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the national government of each beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization if the issuing state is not an Apostille Convention party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (current bank statement or utility bill not older than three months) certified by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank or utility provider, countersigned by a notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter or banker's confirmation of applicant good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the beneficial owner or corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, and Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized corporate resolutions authorizing incorporation and executed UBO declaration form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory electronic screening of all directors, shareholders, signatories and UBOs against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK sanctions list, and any domestic RMI designations. Enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, is mandatory for foreign and domestic PEPs, their family members and close associates, in accordance with the AML/CFT Act 2014, the 2015 Regulations, and FIU Guidance Notes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); name clearance and reservation are submitted through licensed registered agents using the Registrar's authorized electronic filing interface and public name search database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in Latin (Roman) characters; English is the working language of the Registry. Non-Roman script names must be transliterated into Roman characters and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any name already reserved or registered. The name must include a recognized corporate designator such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Company', or an approved abbreviation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Banking / Banker (requires financial institution license or competent ministry consent)
Trust / Trust Company (requires authorized fiduciary license)
Insurance / Assurance / Reinsurance (requires insurance regulatory license)
University / College / Institute (requires education authority consent)
Government / Republic / State / Ministry (implies state sponsorship; prohibited absent official authorization)
Cooperative / Foundation (subject to separate statutory registration regimes)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the registered agent may file a request for reconsideration with the Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice. If reconsideration is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review in the High Court of the Marshall Islands within 30 days. A rejected name may be resubmitted after 30 days together with corrective evidence, such as a letter of consent from the competent ministry or from the holder of an existing identical or similar name. A reserved name may be renewed once for an additional 30 days before incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible: a non-resident Business Corporation must maintain a registered office in the Marshall Islands, which may be the office address of its licensed registered agent. No physical operating office in the RMI is required where the Tier-3/4 colocation and bare-metal leasing business is conducted wholly abroad, and no Foreign Investment Business License is required absent domestic business activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated 1% to 3% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection by the Registrar or the FIU for a non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation with no local employees, no local premises, and no local revenue; inspection risk increases materially upon a suspicious transaction report, adverse media coverage, or a formal regulatory request.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCA), Title 9, Chapter 15, Revised Code of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, including Sections 25, 28 and 31.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (statutory form prescribed under Section 28 of the BCA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Corporation may authorize capital stock at any par value (commonly USD 0.001 per share) and no escrow account or capital deposit requirement applies to non-resident exempt entities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WHEREAS the Articles of Incorporation were accepted and the Certificate of Incorporation issued under Section 31 of the Business Corporations Act; NOW THEREFORE the subscriber, having subscribed to 1,000 no-par value shares for USD 1,000 in paid-up capital, RESOLVED that the registered office and appointed Registered Agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, be confirmed as the Corporation's statutory address; RESOLVED FURTHER that [NAME] is appointed President, [NAME] Secretary, and [NAME] Treasurer, each to serve at the Board's pleasure; RESOLVED that the officers may open bank accounts, negotiate data-center colocation leases, engage auditors and legal counsel, and pay formation, licensing and environmental fees. This resolution takes effect immediately and is entered in the corporate minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (through a licensed RMI Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a Name Reservation Application in paper or electronic form checking the proposed corporate name against the RMI corporate register; the name must contain a corporate identifier such as 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Limited'. Pay the reservation fee; the reservation is valid for 30 days and is renewable.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the authorized signatory
Proposed corporate object summary (data center colocation and hosting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name conflicts with an existing registered entity or protected mark, select a modified alternate name and re-file within the same day; obtain a written consent letter from the conflicting entity, or request a Registrar opinion for a definitive search decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarized Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public plus reviewing RMI Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation under Section 28 of the BCA stating the corporate name, registered office and agent in the RMI, authorized share structure and par value, initial directors, and the exempt non-resident status. Each incorporator signs before a notary; the notarized package is delivered to the registered agent for conformity review.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Passport copies of each incorporator and director
Proof of residential address of each director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar flags format or content defects, correct the Articles and re-file through the registered agent within the refusal notice period (typically 5 days) and pay the nominal re-filing fee; request written clarification of the defect list to avoid repeated refusals.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and Statutory Processing of the Incorporation Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the notarized Articles of Incorporation, the required government fee and the agent consent form to the Registrar; select expedited processing (2 business days) or same-day service where available; the Registrar stamps the file and issues an internal docket number.
required_dossiers: Government fee payment evidence (wire or bank transfer)
Cover letter confirming the exempt status election
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a filing is queried for a missing annex, submit the missing document or a certified explanation within 14 days; the expedited track guarantees re-review within 1 business day; unresolved queries may be escalated in writing to the Registrar for a formal determination.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Filing Endorsements
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation containing the corporate number and formation date; the registered agent obtains certified copies; the board of directors then adopts bylaws and opens the statutory minute book and share register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors in the Certificate may be cured by filing a Certificate of Correction under the BCA with the correction fee; if the Certificate is not issued within the SLA, the registered agent escalates in writing requesting expedited printing and countersignature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Corporate Governance Installment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (virtual meeting or Majuro meeting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting of the initial directors; adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution; approve share issuance and enter the paid-up capital in the share register; endorse officer appointments; adopt the corporate banking resolution and opening authority; execute and file the minutes in the corporate book.
required_dossiers: Share certificate stubs and share register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director cannot attend, the action may be taken by unanimous written consent under Section 79 of the BCA; a resigning director is replaced by resolution of the remaining directors and an updated Statement of Directors is filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License Application and Operating Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Business License Application Form under the Business Licensing Act 1990, describing the activity as 'data center colocation, server rack space leasing and bare-metal hosting'; pay the annual license fee according to the revenue-based schedule; upon approval, affix the license to the registered premises.
required_dossiers: Tax clearance letter from the RMI tax authorities
Site address confirmation (lease agreement or landlord consent)
Passport copies of owners, directors and senior managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit a written reconsideration request to the Director of Business Licensing within 15 days of refusal; appeal an adverse renewal or revocation to the Minister of Finance within 30 days; no colocation revenue may be collected until the license is physically issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Due Diligence Assessment and Permit Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Environmental Due Diligence Assessment Registration Questionnaire describing the colocation facility footprint, cooling systems and standby generators; the RMI EPA issues a determination letter and, where required, wastewater discharge and air emission permits prior to commissioning of diesel generators and cooling towers.
required_dossiers: Site plan and equipment floor layout
Standby generator specification and emissions data sheets
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EPA issues a negative determination, submit an abridged Environmental Management Plan within 30 days to demonstrate mitigation; adverse permit conditions may be appealed before the Environmental Appeals Tribunal; commissioning of generators may not occur until the permit is granted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Defense Fire Safety, Structural Review and Building Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Fire and Rescue Service / Majuro Fire Station and the Building Inspectorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the colocation hall architectural and structural plans for raised-floor rack load certification; complete a fire safety inspection covering clean-agent suppression, compartmentation, emergency egress and alarm signaling; obtain the structural load certification and the Fire Safety Certificate for the leased suite.
required_dossiers: Architectural and structural load calculation sheets
Rack loading schedule per data hall bay
Building permit and landlord lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure any cited deficiency within the inspection report abatement period (normally 14 days) and request re-inspection; for structural load exceptions, submit a mitigation study by a licensed engineer and escalate to the Chief Fire Officer for discretion; occupancy is withheld until clearance is issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Occupational Health and Safety Workplace Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Occupational Health and Safety Office, Ministry of Health, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the data center workplace under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2007; prepare a hazard register covering electrical, thermal, and rack-crush risks; submit the emergency response and first-aid plan; upon approval, the OHS registration certificate authorizes staff and tenant occupation.
required_dossiers: Workplace risk assessment covering electrical and thermal hazards
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Comply with any OHS improvement notice within the stated period and file a corrective action plan; request a written extension from the OHS Office; monetary penalties or contested notices may be reviewed before the OHS Appeals Panel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License - Information Technology and Data Processing Services (Tier-3/Tier-4 Data Center Colocation, Rack Space Leasing and Bare-Metal Server Hosting)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 - Environmental Due Diligence Assessment (EDDA) and Permit Registration; a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is not required absent location in sensitive coastal or protected areas; separate wastewater discharge and stationary generator air emission permits may apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Cooling-tower blowdown and sanitary wastewater discharged to municipal sewage must meet RMI EPA quality standards (BOD not exceeding 30 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 30 mg/L, pH 6.0-8.5); standby diesel generators must satisfy RMI air quality thresholds for NOx, SOx and particulate matter; used oil, battery waste and e-waste must be manifested to and disposed by licensed RMI waste carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the RMI Fire and Rescue Service confirming clean-agent suppression (FM-200/Novec), fire compartmentation, emergency egress and alarm signaling; Building Inspectorate structural certification for raised-floor rack loads and typhoon/wind resistance; Occupational Health and Safety workplace registration and clearance under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2007, covering electrical safety, thermal management and confined-space protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); corporate registration, annual fees, and franchise tax: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Justice. Government portal: www.rmigov.info; corporate filings are made through licensed resident agents (no direct public e-filing portal).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned entity obtains its statutory identity by filing Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations through a licensed registered agent, with a registered office in Majuro. The issued Certificate of Incorporation contains the unique registration number, which functions as the entity's tax identifier; non-resident exempt Business Corporations are not separately registered with the Revenue and Taxation Division and receive no TIN. Annual compliance: payment of the BCA annual registration fee and franchise tax by each anniversary date; the registered agent files the annual report and obtains the Certificate of Good Standing. No tax clearance, no in-person presence, and no minimum capital is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under RMI law. Non-resident exempt status is a factual determination, not an elective filing: the Business Corporation qualifies as exempt only if it does not engage in trade or business within the RMI and derives no RMI-source income. Structural elections available: (i) election of non-resident domestic status at incorporation by describing the registered office and confirming no RMI business activity; (ii) continuance/re-domestication of a foreign corporation into the RMI under the BCA; and (iii) for US federal tax purposes, the RMI Business Corporation is a per se foreign corporation under Treas. Reg. § 301.7701-2(b)(8), so no US check-the-box election is permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No_National_VAT_GST_Or_SalesTax - the RMI imposes no value-added tax, goods and services tax, or sales/use tax at the national or municipal level. The only indirect imposition is the RMI Customs Tariff (import duty) on physical goods entering the country.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not_Applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists because no VAT/GST is imposed on colocation leasing, hosting, or any services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None - the RMI has no e-invoicing mandate, real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or digital signature requirement. Paper or PDF invoices are valid; colocation invoices may be issued without government clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not_Applicable - with no VAT/GST regime, export zero-rating and refund mechanics do not exist. RMI source taxation is territorial: the Income Tax Act taxes only income derived from sources within the RMI. Colocation-leasing and bare-metal hosting revenue received by a non-resident Business Corporation from offshore customers, for infrastructure located outside the RMI, is neither RMI-source income nor subject to any RMI indirect tax. If the leased servers were physically located inside the RMI, the entity could be treated as engaged in trade or business in the RMI; however, the standard MH_BC leasing structure keeps the underlying infrastructure, contracts, and billing outside the RMI to preserve the Tax_Exempt_Zone classification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration - Not_Required: no RMI customs export filing applies to services; required only if physical servers/equipment are re-exported from the RMI (then an export entry is filed with RMI Customs).
Bill of Lading - Not_Required: relevant only for physical equipment movements; colocation capacity leasing generates no cargo documentation.
Inward Remittance Certificate - Not_Required: the RMI has no exchange-control or inward-remittance-certification regime; USD wire receipts require no government certification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not operate a domestic central bank or a formal foreign-exchange administration. Prudential oversight of licensed banks is exercised by the Banking Commissioner within the Ministry of Finance, acting through the Banking Commission. The Financial Action Committee functions as the national Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) for AML/CFT supervision. The US dollar (USD) is the sole legal tender and circulating currency under the Compact of Free Association; the Federal Reserve System ultimately guarantees settlement liquidity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility: the RMI has no capital controls and imposes no exchange-control approvals on inward or outward transfers denominated in USD. Capital account movements (equity injections, shareholder loans, distributions) and current account payments (rents, licensing, services) are equally free of exchange-licensing requirements. Profit remittance and dividend repatriation by a Non-Resident Business Corporation are permitted without quantitative limits, subject only to AML/KYC due diligence and the bank's compliance screening. There is no dual-tier exchange market, no surrender obligation, and no requirement to obtain a central-bank permit for foreign borrowing, equity issuance, or offshore disbursement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender rules exist. There is no mandated timeline for the repatriation of export proceeds, no percentage conversion obligation, and no requirement to deposit export earnings into any designated government account. A Non-Resident Business Corporation engaged in data-center colocation leasing may freely retain, disburse, or reinvest offshore and onshore USD receipts without filing any exchange-control declaration. Entities should nevertheless retain auditable records of receipts for AML purposes, as banks may require evidence of the commercial substance of foreign exchange proceeds in the context of suspicious-transaction monitoring.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands (JEMEM) - Main Branch, Majuro
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account (with sub-account capability for client-escrowed colocation deposits)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - Marshall Islands Branch, Majuro (US-chartered, FDIC-insured home bank in Guam)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account / Sweep and Wire Concentration Account
Capital-escalator / long-term infrastructure loan account (not suited for routine treasury operations)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium. RMI is not within the SEPA zone and is viewed by major offshore Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) as a non-core Pacific jurisdiction; most global EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Payoneer) will not onboard an RMI-domiciled Business Corporation due to perceived correspondent-banking compliance burden. Legal constraints: RMI has no domestic EMI licensing regime that would permit a locally domiciled EMI to operate; inbound EMI services are thus unregistered overseas payment services, which banks may flag. If an EMI is used at all, it should be strictly limited to a collection-only conduit (e.g., receiving client ACH/wire payments) with automatic daily sweep to the primary RMI bank account; the EMI must be regulated in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction (US, UK, Singapore) and must provide complete transactional audit trails to satisfy RMI banking scrutiny.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is permitted in principle for low-risk non-resident corporations, but each bank's BSA/AML officer retains discretion to require physical attendance. In practice, Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam will accept a remote opening package if the following are delivered: a board resolution, certified constitutional documents, notarized passports, and a live video interview with at least one director and the beneficial owner, plus a recommendation letter from the RMI-registered agent. If the board cannot obtain remote approval, a single physically present director or authorized signatory may attend an in-person interview at Majuro to complete the account activation within two business days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-Resident (offshore) domicile of the Business Corporation with no physical office or employees in RMI.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Business Corporations Act registration, Certificate of Non-Resident Status, current Certificate of Good Standing, details of the RMI registered agent, an organizational/ownership chart showing ultimate beneficial owners, and a board resolution declaring the absence of RMI-sourced business activities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Purpose of account and expected transaction flows not anchored to a real commercial contract.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed Master Colocation Service Agreement, an annotated client list with legal names and countries, sample monthly invoices, a treasury forecast of monthly ACH/SWIFT volumes, and a narrative business plan describing how the entity leases Tier-3/4 rack space and sells bare-metal hosting services without maintaining a physical RMI data center.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt status interpreted by the bank as a profit-shifting or tax-evasion red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal letter from the RMI Ministry of Finance confirming the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation's exemption status and the statutory basis for such treatment, audited financial statements or management accounts showing arm's-length transfer pricing, and a written tax memorandum by the tax adviser demonstrating that the structure is lawfully premised on the RMI's territorial tax regime.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious source of injected equity capital (ambiguous shareholder contribution provenance).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements or broker account records of the contributing shareholder covering a 12-month period, certified copies of the shareholders' tax returns or wealth sources, a notarized source-of-funds declaration, and signed subscription/board minutes evidencing the capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exposure to sanctioned or high-risk counterparties through data-center clients and vendor payments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening certificates for all clients and counterparties (OFAC, EU, UN), completed beneficial-ownership questionnaires for major clients, a certificate from the compliance officer that no revenues derive from prohibited end-uses or sanctioned jurisdictions, and contractual clauses restricting subleasing to third parties without KYC clearance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant SWIFT MT103 wire from the shareholder's bank to the RMI beneficiary bank's USD account, routed via the bank's US correspondent (typically Bank of Guam's network or a major US clearing bank). For domestic US-sourced capital, an ACH 'Same-Day ACH' credit or Fedwire transfer to the RMI bank's US correspondent account, with beneficiary memo referencing: 'EQUITY CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – MH_BC'. Remittance information field (Field 70) must include the entity identifier 'MH__MH__MH_BC__ISIC_6209_01_DATA_CENTER_COLOCATION_LEASING' and the phrase 'CAPITAL INJECTION – NON-RESIDENT BC – NO EXCHANGE CONTROL APPROVAL REQUIRED'. Verification: the receiving bank issues a credit advice; the treasury team must reconcile against the shareholder subscription resolution and attach a certificate of inward remittance for the entity's accounting records. No RMI government approval, permit, or declaration is required for the equity injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Two-tier clearing architecture: (1) Monthly recurring domestic and regional payments (colocation rack lease fees, bandwidth capacity charges, monitoring software subscriptions) are cleared via US ACH (NACHA) through the RMI bank's US correspondent, or via SWIFT MT103 if the commercial landlord is outside the US; (2) High-value capital expenditures (purchase of servers, network switches, and uninterruptible power supply equipment) are settled through a documentary commercial Letter of Credit issued in USD and governed by UCP600, with the vendor's presenting bank receiving proceeds via SWIFT MT202/MT103 against compliant shipping and test-report documents. Escalation rail: if a same-day guaranteed payment is required for a critical vendor, a Fedwire transfer to the provider's US bank account or a SWIFT MT103 'PANEL' priority wire is used, with the bank's fee schedule pre-agreed in the treasury mandate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Not applicable in the primary structure: RMI is unilaterally dollarized and operates no domestic FX market; since the entity's revenue, operating costs, and capital expenditures are all denominated in USD, no hedging instrument is needed for the core business model.

Plain vanilla OTC spot FX conversion is permissible through the RMI bank's US correspondent for incidental non-USD receipts (EUR, GBP, AUD) at prevailing market rates, without requiring regulatory approval.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not locally available but may be executed through an offshore dealing desk (New York, Singapore, or London) solely to cover a converted non-USD receivable where the client contract is fixed in a foreign currency; such trades must be authorized by a board-level treasury resolution and documented under the entity's standalone FX risk policy.

Cross-currency swaps are not permissible nor practical for an RMI non-resident entity because there is no intragroup multi-currency balance sheet or local regulatory framework recognizing them; boards should avoid synthetic currency structures and instead bill all colocation contracts in USD to eliminate FX exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Report (annual renewal statement and franchise tax return) filed under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, Section 94
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before July 15; fee calculated from authorized share capital on the filing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-filing penalty of 10% of the annual report fee is imposed for each month or part of a month after July 15, up to a maximum of 100%; failure to file and pay for two consecutive years enables the Registrar of Corporations to administratively strike off the corporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Renewal (continuous statutory appointment; confirmation included in the annual report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the date of the annual report or the anniversary of the registered agent agreement; no separate government filing beyond the annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent constitutes non-compliance with BCA Section 52 and can contribute to administrative strike-off; agent resignation without replacement may lead to involuntary dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A private non-resident Business Corporation is not subject to a compulsory independent audit based solely on revenue, asset, or shareholder-count thresholds; audit becomes mandatory only if required by shareholder resolution, court order, articles or bylaws, or an applicable regulated-industry or listing regime.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Marshall Islands law does not prescribe a separate domestic GAAP for private business corporations; financial statements may be prepared under IFRS or US GAAP, with English-language records maintained. No public filing of financial statements is required for an exempt non-resident business corporation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual beneficial-ownership filing is submitted to the Marshall Islands Registrar for a non-resident business corporation. Share transfers require director or board consent, entry of the transfer in the Register of Members, and are reflected through director/officer updates in the annual report; ultimate beneficial owner information remains with the registered agent under internal customer due diligence policies unless a regulated license or competent authority request applies.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; if voluntarily commissioned, a financial statement audit typically ranges from USD 4,000 to USD 9,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax, and no gross receipts tax on non-resident companies with no locally sourced revenue. The only annual sovereign levy is a fixed franchise/registration fee computed against authorized share capital and paid to the RMI Registrar.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Since RMI imposes no income tax, no tax return is filed. The sole annual compliance instrument is the RMI Annual Registration Renewal Form (Corporate Annual Confirmation, filed electronically by the registered agent through the RMI Business Registry portal/registered agent portal).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and franchise fee payment are due on or before the last day of the calendar month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls. The RMI Registrar customarily processes renewals for the forthcoming year during this window.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification number and exact corporate name as recorded on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the RMI registration number issued by the Registrar; a non-resident BC must use the same name as the registered Charter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the registered office in the RMI and the name of the resident registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be the registered agent's physical street address in Majuro or other approved RMI location; a PO Box alone is not sufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers; full names and principal business address of each director, including resident and non-resident Directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may be listed with their foreign business address; the RMI BCA allows all directors to be non-residents, but at least one director must be an individual or corporate entity validly appointed on a board resolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital and share structure, including number of shares and par value per class.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use US Dollars; non-resident companies frequently adopt 500 no-par-value shares or US$ 50,000 par-value shares. Franchise fee tier is computed from this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent confirmation and annual franchise fee calculation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent signature confirms acceptance of continued appointment; the non-resident shareholder need not appear in person.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of good standing and compliance with the Business Corporations Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The director or registered agent must verify no bankruptcy or liquidation proceeding is pending and that the corporation has not violated the BCA or RMI Anti-Money Laundering Regulations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal attracts a 10% surcharge on the annual franchise fee in the first 30 days, plus further cumulative administrative penalties; continued non-payment for a consecutive period triggers suspension of good standing, loss of certificate of good standing, and eventual administrative dissolution by the Registrar. Reinstatement requires payment of all arrear fees and a reinstatement fee.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: RMI has not entered into comprehensive double taxation agreements for income tax purposes. Because no dividend withholding tax is lawfully exigible on outbound distributions, no treaty relief application is required; if a foreign parent jurisdiction grants a credit or exemption for RMI taxes, the taxpayer will typically rely on a Certificate of Good Standing and a Tax Residency Certificate obtained from the RMI Registrar through its registered agent. No TRC in respect of RMI withholding exists.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on royalties and interest paid by an RMI BC to any non-resident is 0%. As RMI does not impose such withholding, treaty reduction provisions are moot.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 0 (Not applicable. RMI has no transfer pricing legislation and imposes no income tax; therefore no Local File, Master File, or country-by-country reporting obligation is triggered for an RMI Business Corporation).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: RMI has no domestic Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) and does not require economic substance reporting. Nevertheless, the entity should maintain genuine commercial substance (physical colocation infrastructure, server hardware, local or contractual staff, real customer contracts, and substantive billing records) to prevent recharacterization as a shell company under foreign anti-abuse rules and to preserve the low-risk AML classification of the data-center colocation business.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Deliberate Misdeclaration of RMI-Sourced Operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting actual colocation services from RMI territory, deriving RMI-source gross revenue, and affirmatively concealing that revenue to exploit the zero-tax regime while improperly claiming pure non-resident status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the RMI Tax and Business Law, disallowance of any available exemptions, assessment of unpaid taxes, and monetary penalties up to 100% of the concealed amount; possible action by the RMI Ministry of Finance and Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly permit false declarations are personally liable for restitution of the avoided tax, civil damages to claimants, and, in egregious cases, are subject to travel bans and imprisonment under RMI criminal fraud statutes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Commercial Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining an RMI BC as a pure holding or conduit that has no data-center assets, no employees or contractors, no physical capacity, and no real customer agreements while claiming the colocation business classification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Registrar may strike the entity from the register, deny renewal of good standing, and impose dissolution; foreign tax authorities may treat the structure as an abusively transparent shell and impose their own penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Disregarded entity consequences may extend to directors under foreign CFC and anti-hybrid rules; directors could face civil liability for fraudulent transfers and, in multi-jurisdictional investigations, personal travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting third-party funds without performing beneficial ownership verification, client due diligence, source-of-funds checks, or transaction monitoring while processing colocation rentals and bare-metal hosting payments; operation without a written and implemented AML/CFT compliance regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and Registrar can impose administrative fines of up to USD 500,000 for corporate breaches, order monitoring/suspension of operations, and revoke the corporate registration for egregious non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face individual fines, personal civil restitution orders, criminal prosecution for facilitating money laundering, and imprisonment up to 20 years for knowingly permitting illicit financial flows.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false annual confirmation, misrepresenting the registered agent, concealment of a change in directors or beneficiaries, submission of forged board resolutions, or failing to disclose a disqualifying sanction against a director.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Business Corporations Act empowers appointment of an inspector, certificate cancellation, and fines not less than USD 10,000 for each false filing; the Registrar may suspend all corporate rights until correction and may initiate prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director who signed a false document is jointly and severally liable for the resulting pecuniary loss to the company and third parties; directors are subject to personal appearance restrictions and extradition-capable criminal liability.
